findings.message: scenario r6_rabbitmq_json__holdout_01: the detection rule expected 2 matches but found 0. 6 document(s) were produced and NOT ONE of them carries any of the fields the rule needs (source.ip, destination.ip). The mapping may well be right; the parser is not producing these fields. Check `extraction` first - if the layout is wrong, every field is empty and every rule fails regardless of where it is mapped.
